name: UsageReportStatus
title: DTx Usage API: where a submission is
description: The exact status of a submission, carried in Task.statusReason.coding on the Task the API answers with. Task.status carries FHIR's nearest reading of it (received, on-hold, accepted, rejected, completed). The authoritative list is packages/contract/src/reason-codes.ts.
